figurative_meaning_en: to have no merit or praiseworthy quality
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পুরনো মেশিনের গুণগান নেই বললেই চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: His work has no redeeming qualities.
This old machine is not worth mentioning in terms of quality.
note: The idiom often appears in the negative form 'গুণগান নেই' to emphasize lack of value.
